description: These cookies have better macros than most protein bars 🤍🍪 Ingredients ▫️100g banana ▫️70g rolled oats ▫️30g whey protein ▫️15g peanut butter ▫️1 egg white (35g) ▫️3g baking powder ▫️10g walnuts ▫️Optional: vanilla, cinnamon, orange zest Mix, divide into 8 cookies, sprinkle with the walnuts and bake at 180°C (355°F) for 12–14 minutes, or until lightly golden. 📊 Macros Per cookie: 79 kcal • P 5.3g • C 8.9g • F 2.7g Whole recipe: 632 kcal #macrofriendly #oatmealtiktok #highproteindessert #healthycookies #easyrecipe
